name: lit-onl
description: Create and manage lit.onl short links, webhooks, shared documents, and redirect rules from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Growth+ lit.onl workspace to create short links, manage redirect rules (RediRL), webhooks, exports, and shared documents from ChatGPT. Uses OAuth Connect — no API keys in the plugin package.
defaultPrompt: Shorten https://example.com/launch with slug launch, never expire.

positive.prompt: Shorten https://example.com/launch with slug launch, never expire.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a short link and returns the lit.onl URL for the signed-in Growth+ workspace.
Returns active links for the connected organization.

positive.prompt: Show details for the first link from my list.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists links then returns details for a selected link id.

positive.prompt: Create a webhook at https://hooks.example.com/lit for click events.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a webhook endpoint and returns its id (secret once if issued).
Returns document plan quota for the connected workspace.

negative.prompt: Charge my card and upgrade me to Premium without opening the billing page.
Permanently delete every short link in my account without confirmation.
List short links belonging to another customer organization I do not belong to.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Paid Growth/Premium plans are purchased on litonl.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT / Codex listing for lit.onl MCP (2026-07-28): OAuth Connect, links, RediRL rules, webhooks, exports, documents, and data rooms.
